what: CODE-GRAPH budgets B1 / B2 / B7 measured on the 100k proxy with the shipped extractor and resolver (tools/code_graph_bench.py, resolver v4, schema 2)
machine: Windows 11, 20 logical CPUs, Python 3.10.6 (.venv), warm file cache

proxy.why_fewer: the proxy is copied library trees; 30,658 files sit in nested node_modules/.venv/venv/vendor dirs the scope prunes by design (13,462 + 9,588 + 4,862 + 380 + ...), 1,448 are .cjs/.mjs (not in the shared code suffix list), 770 exceed MAX_FILE_BYTES=100000

B2_end_to_end_no_refresh.where_the_time_goes: load_config -> apply_env -> truststore.inject_into_ssl imports requests/urllib3/chardet: ~150 ms of a 194 ms in-process run; the graph query itself is 1-5 ms

discarded_runs.why: run as long background jobs, the process spent ~70-90% of its wall time waiting (thread state Wait:Executive, cpu/wall ~0.1-0.3, no memory pressure, no power throttling, reads 0.04 ms in other processes). The same code on the same first 5000 files: 74 s in the stalled process, 10 s in a fresh one. Cause not identified; the bench now records cpu_over_wall and flags contaminated runs.

B7_full_build.memory_note: peak RSS 2.6 GB at 44k files is ~60 KB/file; linear to 100k is ~6 GB

before_optimisation.verdict_extrapolated_to_100k: FAIL: linear 1037 s; resolve alone ~473 s single-threaded

changes: extraction in a process pool (16 workers, units >= 2000 files)
resolver memo tables keyed with the hop depth: type_of, scope chain, is-local, unique-name hits
after_optimisation.same_graph: nodes/edges/unresolved counts equal to the pre-optimisation build; resolver output on the saved proxy facts byte-identical (sha256 of pickled edges+unresolved: py f9063b062d59a06c, ts 84dcb31082cb0eeb, before and after)
after_optimisation.resolve_profile_before: py: 310M type_of calls for 1.3M receivers, 221 of 300 profiled seconds -- 's = s.replace(...)' written k times makes k**6 recursive calls at _MAX_HOPS=6
after_optimisation.memory_note: peak RSS incl. workers 3.1 GB at 44k files; linear to 100k ~7 GB -- open risk, not a B7 criterion
